description: Evaluation oracle (evals/oracle, independent of ontology/operating): sample closed transactions seeded by the run id across the SO/PO/AO/receipt/BC-invoice/mail/SharePoint strata (mail and SharePoint root first: GET-only Graph mail $search over the whole mailbox and drive search for the numbers of the split's closed roots, newest first, every hit visibility-checked and confirmed by the oracle's span rule), compute F1-F4 ground truth from raw Portal API rows and BC documents (GET only), validate each item against evals/item.schema.json and repeat the oracle over the same reads (determinism). Receipts are rooted in gold app_receipt and in FM raw receipts (lab ids); closure follows the Portal's own reads (FM status text; the PO fulfillment code over its lines, derivePoFulfillmentCode, or closed_at, a line-less PO the PO list shows Complete from its header only being a lead counted as closed_by_header_only; the Sage header complete flag). Every stratum reports status, reason, the source it tried, candidates and items per family and a funnel of where rows dropped out; a stratum with no candidate says why (empty with the source tried; no_candidate_in_sample when the readable remainder was read to its end or cut only by the sampler's own caps, with the withheld count; unreadable/incomplete when it was cut otherwise or only withheld items were found; not_configured), never 'read' with 0. The check fails unless all seven strata have at least one candidate. BC number matches count as identity only within one company and the PO's vendor; other matches leave a gap. Publishes item ids, 16-hex item hashes and pass counts only; item values stay in {tmp}.
notes: live-unverified until a passing live-check result. Exit 0 requires every item schema-valid and deterministic (exit 3 otherwise). The check fails until every one of the seven strata has at least one candidate (strata.<kind>.candidates >= 1): a stratum reported empty with a reason, unreadable, incomplete, unavailable or not_configured is recorded honestly and still fails. BC and Graph need their variables (and SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID for SharePoint); without them those strata report not_configured with the reason and the check fails on them. The SharePoint search covers the whole SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID drive (strata.sharepoint.tried sharepoint:/); --sharepoint-path still says SharePoint is asked for and bounds the cross-system sample's folder walk. unexplained_strata stays a diagnostic gate: a stratum read with 0 candidates and no reason, or empty without the source it tried (the 250eae4 run read 0 for five strata silently). Run id 'auto' = live-<UTC hour>, so each hourly run draws a new sample. Items are never committed from a live run: dev items in evals/dev are fixture-only until a person approves committing live-derived values. Root first: across three full document-first runs (305/304/400 mails, 822/842/486 number spans) only 4/4/3 spans named a Portal row, all open, and SharePoint's 360 none, so the documents are no longer read first. Root first then found 0-1 mail and 16-17 SharePoint files naming no root in 23-24 searches per source (2bf15f5, 2d141d7): the roots were drawn at random over all history, the mail search stayed in the inbox (the purchase-order@ inbox held 4 messages in 90 days, graph.mail_capture live-2026-10-02T02:02Z; Petra's own PO mail sits in sent items, which case.po_mail_links reads for purchase-order@ and vince@: roles petra_outgoing 8, supplier_message 4), and a number written apart from its label named nothing (case.po_mail_links grammar_form_lead 12 of 76 PO values, as many as the exact claims). Hence newest roots first, the whole mailbox and labelled leads. The mail and SharePoint strata search (GET only: Graph mail $search over the whole --mailbox without its drafts, outbox, deleted items, recoverable deletions and junk (counted funnel.documents_excluded), drive search over SHAREPOINT_DRIVE_ID, each hit opened through the reader's audience and ACL check, refused ones counted withheld) for the numbers of the split's closed roots (every record stratum's candidates, the closed BC invoices sampled and the closed BC orders and posted receipts read for the search, strata.bc_invoice.document_roots, newest first: posted receipts by posting date and sales orders by order date as BC sorts them, purchase orders, which the BC grammar sorts by no field, the newest by order date of one read of 1000 per company (scripts/eval_oracle_dev.py LiveBcPort._sample), so a Portal outage leaves BC's roots; live 2b0ee89 searched 24 of 6088 closed Portal and BC invoice roots per source and the mail named none, its PO values all above every Portal PO row read, case.po_mail_links), round robin over the record strata, each stratum's dated roots (evals/oracle/generator.py root_when) in windows of 24 from the newest, the roots of one window in a sample seeded by the run id so hourly runs draw different recent roots, the undated ones such as BC roots after them ranked by the run id, 24 roots per source (strata.<kind>.funnel.roots_searched), 5 documents per search, the text of 48 hits read (mail bodies; SharePoint text as capture reads it, OCR included). A hit names a root only when one of its separator-bounded spans names it exactly or by a licensed prefix/zero-padding lead, a label written apart from its number included (synthetic 'PO 1234' or 'P.O. # 1234' for PO#1234 or PO1234: a lead only, funnel span_labelled) (PO#12345 never names PO#1234; a name two closed records share names neither, except a BC order the Portal drained under a Portal record's own number on a declared identity edge, which the oracle's walk from that record finds for its own vendor: one transaction, so the name names the Portal record, evals/oracle/generator.py twins); an unchecked BC root is then checked by the oracle's single-root lookup. Roots none of whose hits named them are searched once more for each number without its leading letters (at most 24, funnel fallback_searches). A search the access guard (the read-only guard included), audience or query grammar refuses is search_refused_guard, one Graph answers 400/403/501 search_refused_tenant. Mostly refused is judged per root: a root is refused when none of its searches (its numbers and their fallbacks) was answered and one was refused (funnel.roots_refused beside funnel.roots_asked, both recorded when a search was refused), so a root with several numbers weighs as one; a refusal naming no query counts only a root none of whose searches failed (a failed search is search_failed, unavailable, never refused); more roots refused than not is status unavailable (nothing found) or incomplete (a document found), reason search_refused, never a sample. Zero naming hits is status no_candidate_in_sample, reason no_document_names_root, with funnel.roots_searched; the live acceptance is candidates >= 1 per document stratum, else no_document_names_root with funnel.roots_searched >= 20 (json_min keeps both: the owner rule still fails the check without a candidate). status_out_of_vocabulary counts the PO headers outside the Portal's words, its PurchaseOrderStatus enum and the FM labels its PO writers copy (Generated, Pending, B.Order, Complete, Cancel; live 2b0ee89 counted 5504 of 5866 without them, though a PO's closure reads its lines). The cross-system sample (eval.unfamiliar_sample) takes its document references through the same search (generator.document_candidates). Every read (Portal, BC, mail, SharePoint listing and document text, OCR included) stops at the run's read deadline (--budget-seconds, 1200 s, inside the 1500 s timeout): one still running then is abandoned and its stratum is blocked: budget, so the run always prints its report with budget.exhausted (live 37e539e6 was killed at the timeout with no JSON: the guard only ran before each read). A source that refused every search it was asked (mail: the tenant answers 403 to $search and to the listing that stands in for it, search_refused_tenant on every root, roots_refused = roots_asked) is blocked: upstream with the refusal's http_status and error_code and listed in blocked_upstream (counts.blocked_upstream), so the run reads blocked (later_ask graph-mail-directory-consent), never a pass and never a silent fail; one answered search keeps the stratum measured. expect_blocked therefore no longer requires strata.mail.candidates (a blocked mail stratum has none; the expect floor of 1 is unchanged), and SharePoint is never asked to fill mail. Live live-2026-10-20T22:59:46Z (results/latest.json) failed strata.mail.candidates < 1 and strata.sharepoint.candidates < 1 with reason no_document_names_root, 24 roots searched each: the mailbox search returned 5 documents in 31 searches, none naming a closed root; across the 14 results of 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20 the mail stratum had a candidate 0 times and SharePoint 2 times (live-2026-10-19T04:58:41Z, live-2026-10-20T00:58:03Z). The sampler read to its caps and found no document naming a root, so the assertion is not wrong and the stratum is a source gap, not a sampler defect; it stays red and typed by strata.<kind>.reason (docs/decisions/open-live-1020-oracle-dev-document-strata.md). People guard: a mailbox the guard refuses (PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS unset or invalid) is asked once and refused before any request; the mail stratum reports unavailable/scope with 0 candidates and blocked_upstream names it typed {part mail, source people-exclusion, cause later_ask, later_ask excluded-people-oids}, so the check reads blocked on mail (still failing on any other stratum) rather than failed, with SharePoint read in the same run.
